## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch name follows the standard in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#branch-names) (for example `feat/123-short-description`)
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (and `npm run test:e2e` if the UI changed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behaviour
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md`) when behaviour or setup changes
- [ ] My commits are signed (verified badge on GitHub)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, customer data or personal data in code, tests, screenshots or logs
- [ ] `manifest.yml`: no new scope, module, egress or storage entity, or I explain why below
